changelog:
- Initial release of the fitness-trainer skill.
- Provides workout programming for all levels, including full-body, upper/lower, and push/pull/legs splits.
- Offers guidance on progressive overload, rep ranges, and exercise selection.
- Includes basic nutrition advice: macronutrients, calorie targets, and meal timing.
- Advises on common mistakes and effective recovery practices.
- Useful for workout plans, nutrition questions, exercise form, and training progression.
summary: Fitness and workout assistant. Helps with exercise plans, nutrition advice, workout programming, and training progression. Use when someone asks about fitness, exercise, nutrition, or wants help with their training program.
